<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex50032023-09-191" status="unreviewed"> <milestone unit="section" n="Transmission lineage (4b8-5a5)"/>
            chos 'di'i lo rgyus <rs type="person" ana="">paN di ta chen po byaMs</rs> (<rs type="person" ana="">rgyal ba byaMs pa</rs>'i chos 2 yod pa'i) <rs type="person" ana="">pa'i mgon po</rs>| zhes bya ba <rs type="place">ma ga da'i dgon pa</rs> 1 na bzhugs pa la| rmi laM <lb edRef="inst:4837" n="5a1"/> (btsun pa 1 gdugs dkar po 1 phub nas lha'i 'khor mang po dang 'dug) du <rs type="place">tsan dan gyi mchod rten khri 'phang 4 pa 1 </rs>gi nang du <rs type="work">rgyud bla ma</rs> dang ||  <rs type="work">chos nyid kyi gdaM[s] ngag</rs> 2 btsug nas <rs type="deity">byaMs pa</rs> dngos kyis ngo sprod byas te | spyir rgyu rkyen 2 'bras bu 3 du dril nas ngo sprod pa dang | <lb edRef="inst:4837" n="5a2"/> bye brag tu rgyu chos nyi mi 'gyur bar ngo sprad pa dang | bsaM mi khyab 4 lo ngo sprod mdzod || phyis gnyid sad pa dang chos 'ga' seMs la byung kyang ma rga ba las | 'phags pa dngos kyi thugs rjes | <lb edRef="inst:4837" n="5a3"/> bzung kyang nga la chos 'dzin pa'i nus pa med_do snyaM mo || de nas sngar skor ba byed pa'i <rs type="place">mchod rten 1</rs> la| 'od snga na med pa de nas byung_ngo || de nas gdaM[s] ngag yod daM snyaM nas phye bas byung_ngo|| </seg></TEI>
